messages:
marta: Heads-up — after today's deploy the internal quota header was renamed from `x-redwood-rateplan` -> `x-redwood-quota-namespace` and we're seeing SDK/console mismatches. Console logs: "unknown header 'x-redwood-rateplan'". Anyone hit this in the wild?
kevin: Yep, telemetry spike this morning. Looks like the console canary still emits the old header for some routes. Which SDK versions?
sasha: Repro?
marta: Repro steps: curl against /v1/infer with header set: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-redwood-rateplan: team-analytics" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Response shows 400 from quota service: "unknown header". python client uses header mapping from transport layer, so it's failing to wire.
nana: (typo) meant ana: if console is still emitting old header during canary, SDKs should accept both during a grace period — prefer new header if present. that avoids immediate breakage. :thumbsup:
nana: also recommends adding an opt-in env var `RW_ACCEPT_LEGACY_RATEPLAN=true` for quick rollback in customers.
jordan: We can add fallback parsing in Go and TS pretty quickly (small patch to transport layer). Go needs someone to own the release though. I can take it if needed.
kevin: Important: avoid double-attribution in metrics. If both headers present prefer `x-redwood-quota-namespace`. Add unit that simulates dual headers.
marta: Plan proposal: publish a patch that accepts both headers, add unit/integration tests, and coordinate console canary to flip to new header 24h after the SDK patch is in the wild. Rollout Wednesday EOD?
sasha: Telemetry question — will console mapping render old names in the UI? That will confuse customers if SDKs accept both but UI shows legacy.
kevin: Console UI still uses legacy label; we need a small mapping table in the UI that shows `quota namespace (was: rateplan)` during transition. Low risk change.
nana: (ana) I'll open PRs for python+ts today: python patch will touch `redwood/transport/headers.py` to read both keys; ts will change `src/transport/headers.ts` analogously.
jordan: I'll own Go. I'll add env var opt-in and tests.
dev-bot: deploybot: canary deployment for console header rename at 2% started (6054322010).
marta: Thanks all — I've created RN-2024-57 to track this, will post PR links and the exact rollout timeline. If anyone sees a failing customer report ping me directly. :heart:
kevin: One more: add a short note in Breaking Changes page and send an email to platform integrators before the flip.
sasha: Agreed. Also add an observability alert to detect dual-header submissions so we can measure adoption.
marta: Ok locking this down. ETA for SDK patches: EOD today for python/ts, EOD tomorrow for Go. Will coordinate canary schedule once PRs land.
